modules.name: core
modules.label: pogls_core
modules.desc: Platform abstraction, compression API, 144² address space, v2 metadata format, standalone loader
modules.design_note: Zero external dependencies. Platform layer isolates all OS-specific code (Win32/POSIX) in pogls_platform.h/.c. pogls_loader.h is a header-only standalone loader for external runners (llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM) with implementation toggle via POGLS_LOADER_IMPLEMENTATION.

files.purpose: Platform abstraction: VirtualAlloc/mmap, 64-bit file I/O, xorshift32 PRNG
Platform impl — #ifdef _WIN32 branches for VirtualAlloc/CreateFileMapping/gmtime_s
Compression API: RAW/ZSTD/SHELL/DELTA/GEOPIXEL per-tensor, auto-fallback to RAW when ratio < 1.1x
Compression impl — guarded by #define POGLS_USE_ZSTD
144²=20736 address space. Tier0-3 decomposition: macro(128)×micro(162). capo() face rotation, FNV-1a name hash
Address space impl — FNV-1a hash→macro/micro, capo face offset, tier selection
POGLS v2 format: header (magic+version+flags) + tensor meta array + optional model meta blob
Format read/write — binary search by address or name, v1 backward compat
Umbrella include — single #include "pogls_core.h" gets all sub-headers
Store contract interface — forward-declared PoglsStore with 11 lifecycle/query functions
Standalone loader API for external runners — mmap zero-copy tensor access, face rotation, error reporting

modules.name: gguf
modules.label: pogls_gguf
modules.desc: Standalone GGUF file parser — no llama.cpp dependency. Type-size table for 31 GGML types
modules.design_note: Pure stdio — parses header, KV metadata, tensor index. 64-bit offset support throughout. Replaces project's legacy gguf_reader.h + gguf_index.h.

files.purpose: Public API: PoglsGgufReader + PoglsGgufIndex structs, open/read/close, type queries
Full GGUF parser — type-size table (31 types), KV skip, tensor index, 64-bit offset

modules.name: geo
modules.label: pogls_geo
modules.desc: Y-triangle coordinate system: 144²=20736, face jump, triplet topology, FNV-1a name hash
modules.design_note: 128×162 = 144² = 20736. 128=2⁷ (head_dim power-of-2), 162=2×3⁴ (Y-triangle faces). Pure integer math, no float, no hash collision. 12-face pentagon triplet table baked inline.

files.purpose: Geo API: coord decompose/compose, face jump, name hash, triplet table, tier name, address validation
Geo impl — full decompose algorithm, FNV-1a hash, 12-face pentagon triplet table

modules.name: dram
modules.label: pogls_dram
modules.desc: Flat-arena DRamTile: put/get by addr or name, KV ephemeral flag, save/load persistence
modules.design_note: Single VirtualAlloc block: [header | directory[512] | data arena]. Linear scan (~25µs worst-case). No hash, no geo_jump dependency. Max 512 entries, POGLS_DRAM_KV_FLAG bit 31 masking.

files.purpose: DRamTile API: open/close, put/get by addr or name, free, save, stats, has
DRamTile impl — flat arena layout, directory[512] linear scan, KV flag masking

modules.name: bermuda
modules.label: pogls_bermuda
modules.desc: Stride-37 geometry router, Diamond Shell 3D cube codec, RLE, shadow bonds, zone scoring
modules.design_note: Hilbert encode → zone mapping → 4 traverse modes (orbit/chiral/cross/hub). Diamond Shell: 4×4×4 cube with 6 rotation orientations. Shadow bond: ring buffer of 144 entries.

files.purpose: Bermuda API: route, face scores, diamond compress/decompress, RLE, shadow read/write
Bermuda full impl — Stride-37, Diamond Shell encode/decode, RLE, shadow ring buffer

modules.name: kv
modules.label: pogls_kv
modules.desc: Adaptive KV remap: ENTROPY/GEO/REBUILD delta + 3-lane rail scanner, freeze/resume
modules.design_note: classify() compares cur vs base in 4096B strides. Auto-tier: 0-15% ENTROPY (XOR+RLE), 15-85% GEO (byte-offset ranges), 85%+ REBUILD. Max 4096 geo ranges.

files.purpose: KV API: skeleton init/destroy, classify, encode/decode, rail init/step/freeze/resume/free
KV impl — RLE compress/decompress, GEO range delta, 3-lane round-robin rail

modules.name: geopixel
modules.label: pogls_geopixel
modules.desc: 64B block codec: FLAT(2B)/SMOOTH(10B)/GRADIENT(10B)/EDGE(65B) + Hilbert 2D curve + session tracking
modules.design_note: Classify 64B block by variance: FLAT (2B header+mean), SMOOTH/GRADIENT (10B predictor), EDGE (65B raw). 8×8 Hilbert order-3 curve for spatial locality. No libpng, no file I/O, no heap in hot path.

files.purpose: Geopixel API: encode/decode block, full tensor, Hilbert XY↔D, session feed/stats
Geopixel impl — block classify, variance compute, Hilbert 2D 8-bit, session frame counter

modules.name: hilbert-container
modules.label: pogls_hilbert_container
modules.desc: Hilbert L-Block container format: 3×64B cells + 32B connector, GeoJump integration, file I/O
modules.design_note: L-block = 3 cells × 64B = 192B data + 32B connector = 224B unit. Container: [Header 20B] [L0 192B][C0 32B] ... Hilbert order N → 4^N cells. GeoJump variant uses Metatron blocks (3 floors × 16 cells). Both header-only with static inline implementations.

files.purpose: Hilbert container: L-block writer/reader, Hilbert curve (order N), file I/O roundtrip, spatial locality verification
GeoJump integration: Metatron Hilbert floors, node decompose, geojump walk over L-blocks
